title: feat(picker): a clear button in the team search field
body:
**Size:** S

Clearing the team picker's search takes a long backspace. Add a × button inside `components/SearchField.tsx` that empties the field and keeps the keyboard up. It is the picker's search field, CLAUDE.md guardrail 3's one exception, so nothing changes about answering.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The × appears only when the field has text, and VoiceOver reads it as "Clear search"
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
why: An S feature on main with someone's uncommitted edit in the tree: a worktree keeps that edit safe.
